rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 111, Line 1a: "If you, your spouse with whom you are filing a joint return, or your dependent was enrolled in coverage purchased from the Marketplace and advance payments of the premium tax credit were made for the coverage, complete Form 8962 ... If the advance credit payments were more than the premium tax credit you can claim, the amount you must repay will be shown on Form 8962, line 29. Enter that amount, if any, on line 1a". The project enters zero when no Form 1095-A is listed (f8962.any false, i8962 p. 3, Who Must File); the candidate copies the Form 8962 line on every return, so a filer with no Marketplace coverage must answer Form 8962's questions (f8962.alloc, f8962.fpl_table, each dependent's ptc_files) and reach its household income. Triage executable-triage-v2 (triage/s2.json; 1,222 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 80 partial records): 466 of 1,802 agree; 844 candidate-unknown (442 on completed returns: classm.f2441.1.deepseek to .6.deepseek, project $0.00, candidate stops on f8962.alloc and f8962.fpl_table), 492 candidate-refuses, all on refused returns (classm.w2.1.deepseek, classm.f8889.2.deepseek, classm.g28.2.deepseek: refusals reached through Form 8962's household income, for example f2441.line26 through AGI); no value differs. The published interface offers f8962.any, so the guard was expressible: not an interface gap. Project stands.

Ruling: equivalent; project retained. Both are zero within scope (the alternative minimum tax is refused through s2.amt); the second copies the zero parameter sales.zero where the project writes the constant 0.

Ruling: equivalent; project retained. Line 3 is "Add lines 1z and 2" (f1040s2 p. 1, line 3); line 1z is zero within scope because every line 1 item is refused by s2.other ("Any amount on Schedule 2 other than self-employment tax from Schedule SE, Additional Medicare Tax or Net Investment Income Tax"), and line 2 is zero because the alternative minimum tax is refused by s2.amt. The second copies line 2, which is zero, where the project writes the constant 0, as ruled before.
